text.title: FreshDrop, 10 September 2026, v3
text.problem: no time to shop; missing items; late couriers
text.alternatives: supermarket visits, or supermarket delivery slots booked a day ahead
text.solution: weekly list in the app; live stock picking; 2-hour slots
text.metrics: weekly orders per buyer; on-time rate; repeat rate in week 4
text.uvp: groceries in 2 hours, every item in stock
text.advantage: own dark-store network and two years of stock data
text.channels: referral codes, metro posters, Telegram ads
text.early_adopters: parents with 2+ children and no car
text.costs: dark stores 40 M, couriers 25 M, marketing 15 M a year
text.revenues: 12% margin on goods, delivery fee below 1 500 ₽
